checks.details: HPCI Train A coupling annual inspection overdue 197 days. Deferred during last outage. PM overdue at time of part replacement — but replacement is a new part, so overdue inspection is a programmatic finding rather than a direct cause.
HPCI Train B coupling inspection current. Completed per schedule. No degradation found on previous coupling — replaced with new part during outage.

summary.notes: Train A PM overdue undermines independent-wear hypothesis: if wear were the root cause, Train B (with current PM) should not have failed simultaneously. The symmetry of failure despite PM asymmetry supports CCF over independent wear.
